\caption{\textbf{Closing the loop at 13 \nfe} (\flux, $\delta = 0.6$, $3.8\times$ fewer transformer evaluations than the 50-step reference). \seacache (our run of its released gate) reuses the last computed residual on skipped steps; \ours forecasts it with a Kalman filter and corrects each skipped gap once the next step is computed (\pcgs). Fixed selection rule: among the 188 of 200 held-out DrawBench prompts on which the two caches computed the same steps, those whose PSNR gain of \ours over \seacache is closest to the median (+1.19\,dB; left) and the upper quartile (+2.40\,dB; right). Crops ($256\times128$ of $1024^2$ pixels) are placed where the cached images differ most, without using the reference. Numbers: PSNR (dB) to the reference, best in bold.}
